major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the GCD after Fury of Elune together with your on-use trinket, and fill the window with Starfire and Starsurge instead of dots.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 102560 is cast and self aura in 5/5 sampled parses. Table base_cd_s is 180, but the guide states a two minute recharge for the Celestial Alignment / Incarnation node and says it banks two charges, so 120 is used. talent_gated because it is the choice-node alternative to Celestial Alignment.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Alignment
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the GCD after Fury of Elune or Force of Nature, and hold a charge for an incoming mechanic as long as you are not sitting on two.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not cast in the sampled parses, which all took Incarnation: Chosen of Elune; castable per its tooltip. Table base_cd_s is 180 while the guide states a two minute recharge.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on the GCD before Incarnation or Eclipse, or straight off cooldown when you are playing Lunation.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 202770 is the cast id seen in 5/5 parses (74 casts); 211545 and 394111 share the name and are never cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Eclipse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter it on the GCD after Fury of Elune with Astral Power pooled, and never sit on two charges.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1233272 is the Eclipse cast observed in 5/5 parses; Solar Eclipse is the separate cast id 1233346 sharing the same charges, and the generic Eclipse talent id 1239669 never appears as a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Force of Nature
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it only when Eclipse or Incarnation is ready and open that window on the next GCD, since its value is the 12% damage amp while the treants are out.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Keeper of the Grove talent, castable per its tooltip but not cast in the sampled parses, which all played Elune's Chosen.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it inside your Force of Nature or Celestial Alignment window at as little Astral Power as possible so its free Starsurges do not overcap you.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Castable per its tooltip but not cast in the sampled parses; the guide lists it as an opt-in cooldown talent.

major_cooldowns.name: Wild Mushroom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it in AoE to generate Astral Power while you are moving, and leave it out of single-target fights.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Castable per its tooltip but not cast in the sampled parses; the guide describes it as an opt-in AoE button.

major_cooldowns.name: Empowering Venom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pop your on-use trinket in the same GCD window as Incarnation or Celestial Alignment.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket cast in 5/5 sampled parses (22 casts); the guide names the trinket slot generically through Inscrutable Quantum Device (330323). talent_gated so players in a different trinket are not flagged for zero casts.

rule.description: Open with dots, Fury of Elune, then Incarnation
rule.action: Get your dots down first, send Fury of Elune, then press Incarnation on the next GCD and dump Astral Power with Starsurge.

rule.description: Incarnation on the GCD after Fury of Elune
rule.action: Line Fury of Elune up so it goes out on the GCD before you press Incarnation.

rule.description: Enter Lunar Eclipse with Astral Power banked
rule.action: Build Astral Power before you press it so the window opens with Starsurges ready to fire.

rule.description: Starfire is your filler inside Eclipse
rule.action: Press Starfire, not Wrath, while you are inside an Eclipse.
Reapply Moonfire before it drops, and top it up on the way into your cooldown window rather than inside it.
Reapply Sunfire before it drops, and top it up on the way into your cooldown window rather than inside it.

rule.description: Spend Touch the Cosmos on Starsurge or Starfall
rule.action: Fire the free Starfall or Starsurge before the proc expires, and only hold it into a cooldown window when you will not munch it.
